_comment: RULE 11: the single source of truth. No literal number, path, port, limit, label or rule-of-thumb may appear anywhere else in the code. core/ and server/ read it through core/constants.ts; the UI imports the same file. The core/ferrite catalogue is data and lives in library.json.

app.name: Planar Studio
app.tagline: Planar transformer design on a multilayer PCB — from Vin/Vout to a KiCad board.

physics._comment: SI. Copper resistivity at 20 °C and its temperature coefficient (IEC 60028 annealed copper).

pcb._comment: Fabrication defaults. oz_um: finished copper thickness per weight. min_space_mm/min_trace_mm: typical standard-class rules per copper weight (heavier copper etches wider). eps_r and breakdown are FR-4/prepreg screening values.
pcb._jog: A spiral steps to the next turn over a transition jog_pitch_factor x turn pitch long (cosine ramp); where it climbs it is closer to its neighbour than the pitch, so the layout spacing is widened to keep min_space there.

isolation._comment: Screening rules, not a certification. DTI: reinforced insulation through PCB laminate uses the 0.4 mm distance-through-insulation rule (IEC 62368-1 / 60950 style). Test voltage scales with working voltage; required thickness = test peak / (breakdown x derating). Creepage: IEC 60664-1 pollution degree 2, material group III, basic insulation, mm vs working Vrms; reinforced = 2x.

thermal._comment: Natural-convection estimate for a ferrite core: dT[°C] = (P[mW] / A_surface[cm²])^0.833 (Ferroxcube / Magnetics application notes). The PCB spreads heat as well, so pcb_area_credit of the board area within one core-length around the core counts as surface.

magnetics._comment: bsat_margin: allowed peak flux as a fraction of Bsat at 100 °C. residual_gap_mm: what a ground ungapped mating surface behaves like. fringing uses McLyman's factor F = 1 + lg/sqrt(Ae) * ln(2 G / lg).

optimiser._comment: Search bounds. ns_max: largest secondary turn count tried. ratio_tol: accepted relative error of Np/Ns against the target (flyback and LLC tolerate more because duty or frequency absorbs it). top_n: candidates kept in the table.

topology_defaults._comment: Starting spec per topology, so switching topology gives a design that works. Units: V, A, Hz, s, F, °C.

spec_defaults._lossBudget: Allowed transformer loss as a percentage of Pout. With the default 'smallest core' objective this is what stops the search from just picking the largest core.
spec_defaults._singleTurnLayers: true lets the search put one wide turn on a layer (lowest resistance, needs a via per turn). false spreads turns as spirals of two or more per layer; a winding of only one turn is exempt.

limits._comment: Input bounds the form accepts. Anything outside is rejected with the field named.
